summary: Tested the public APIs and Clerk config with pytest (6 of 6 passed), plus the UI with Playwright: home hero, featured templates, sports grid, /sign-in, /explore, /pricing, /help and the /create cricket flow. Every requested feature works. The centre hero card is Arjun Mehra on the Legendary template and shows 72 matches, 3,184 runs, 14 wickets, a highest score of 176*, a 52.4 batting average and a 138.6 strike rate. /sign-in renders the Clerk email form (Development mode, pk_test_ key). No console errors or page errors.
action_items: Optional: the old test files backend/tests/test_rivalcard_api.py and test_rivalcard_extra.py import /app/scripts/clerk_users.py, which does not exist, so those suites cannot run. They also need real Clerk test users. Remove them or restore the helper.
critical_code_review_comments: clerk_auth.py: the fallback 'CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY or CLERK_OWN_PUBLISHABLE_KEY' works because the primary vars are empty strings. If a platform key is ever set again, it silently overrides the user's own keys. Consider preferring the CLERK_OWN_* vars.
server.py is 911 lines; consider splitting it into routers.
DEMO_PLAYERS has 5 entries and 8 templates cycle through them (i % 5), so the Arjun Mehra card appears twice in the featured carousel (Classic Athlete and MVP Edition). This is cosmetic only.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty. No test user exists, so sign-in was not completed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clerk is enabled with the user's own pk_test_ and sk_test_ keys (CLERK_OWN_*). The full sign-in flow and authenticated endpoints are untested because there are no credentials. The editor testids are editor-tab-{sport,design,photo,details,stats,style}, sport-option-{id}, detail-name-input and live-card-preview.
